newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks gain 7.21 pct on heavy buying.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks gain 7.21 pct on heavy buying.

text.p: Heavy buying by small investors encouraged by good corporate news pushed Dhaka stocks higher on Wednesday.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) index closed 190.11 points or 7.21 percent up at 2,823.62. Turnover was 373.43 million taka. Of the 116 issues traded 101 rose, 12 lost and three unchanged.

"Many buyers did not get shares even by offering very high price. Selling declined amid expectation of heavy gains," said one broker. Apex Foods rose 792.02 taka to 20,000 and Singer Bangladesh gained 2,161 to 23,771.
